The '''Coruscant Spaceport Authority''' was the agency in charge of the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It monitored traffic around the spaceport.
